albums.title: Almost Waking
albums.sources: Treble Zine · The Line of Best Fit
albums.description: Critics praise this album for its dynamic and unpredictable sound, blending Fratti's nuanced melodies with Orcutt's ecstatic improvisations to create a work that is both gorgeous and immediate, often described as ambient pop.

albums.title: Little Wide Open
albums.description: This album is considered a creative high water mark for the artist, with critics noting how the restless songwriter turns inward to explore themes of love, distance, and life on the road.

albums.title: Mi Catedral
albums.description: Critics enthusiastically note that this album quickly establishes its distinctive sound, making listeners forget previous works and showcasing the band's unique post-punk style.

albums.title: Norteña
albums.description: Julieta Venegas delivers a non-traditionalist and heartfelt tribute to norteña music, drawing inspiration from her childhood in Tijuana.

albums.title: Birding
albums.description: This debut album from the London-based trio is lauded for its special sound, deeply rooted in shoegaze and dreamy pop, evoking comparisons to influential bands like Slowdive and The Cocteau Twins.

albums.title: NOISE FACE LANDSCAPE
albums.description: This album features an eclectic collection of tracks, including an oriental mood cha-cha and a Yo La Tengo cover, with some pieces inspired by 90s Chinese home videos, showcasing an avant-garde and ambient sensibility.
